opening.argument: The video frames OneCoin for scrutiny, asking whether it is a scam while examining its promise that people are earning millions of euros each month. It questions how the claimed earnings arise, explains that participation involves registration and investment, and emphasizes that earning requires bringing in additional investors whose larger contributions are tied to greater returns. Rather than urging viewers to join, the speakers warn them not to get caught up in this scheme and to pay attention. The discussion therefore challenges the opportunity’s promises and cautions against participation, without establishing that viewers should send money or data through the external link.
